root: refs/kinematics (papers and figures from the two PLOS ONE CC BY articles only)
note: CC BY needs attribution (authors + licence + source). Only open-access CC BY material is stored here. Everything else was read for numbers and is cited in poses.md but not redistributed: RA01, MR01, RH01, HE06, HGRS06, BA08, AT15 (arXiv non-exclusive licence or publisher copyright). Figure-derived numbers in poses.md were read at the zoom levels listed per item.
not_obtained: Paywalled or abstract-only, no files stored: Tobalske 1995 (J Exp Biol 198:1259; mid-upstroke span numbers and bound percentages not obtained), Dial, Goslow & Jenkins 1991 (J Morphol 207:327; humerus convention not obtained), Ward et al. 2001 (J Exp Biol 204:3311), Rosen, Spedding & Hedenstrom 2004 (J Exp Biol 207:4255; thrush nightingale span ratios not obtained), Hedrick & Biewener 2007, Ros et al. 2011 (abstracts only). Read but copyrighted or non-exclusive, not stored: Rayner et al. 2001 (Am Zool 41:188), Maybury, Rayner & Couldrick 2001 (Proc R Soc B 268:1443, starling tail spread), Rosen & Hedenstrom 2001 (jackdaw glide), Hedenstrom, Rosen & Spedding 2006 (robin), Ballerini et al. 2008 (arXiv 0802.1667), Attanasi et al. 2015 (arXiv 1410.3330), Hildenbrandt et al. 2010 (arXiv 0908.2677). CC BY but not stored, no kinematic numbers used: Storms et al. 2019 (PMC6404399), PMC13448496, PMC11061643. No open-access source gives starling mid-upstroke or glide outlines, a starling bank angle, tail fan angles in flight, or dihedral.
